Vendored front-end libraries. Update by reinstalling the pinned version and copying the dist file.

htmx.org   2.0.10   static/vendor/htmx.min.js          BSD-2-Clause
gsap       3.15.0   static/vendor/gsap.min.js           GSAP Standard "no charge" license (https://gsap.com/standard-license)
                    static/vendor/ScrollTrigger.min.js
lenis      1.3.26   static/vendor/lenis.min.js          MIT
                    static/vendor/lenis.css

GSAP and Lenis are loaded ONLY on the landing page. The directories stay on
htmx + a few lines of vanilla JS, per CLAUDE.md.
